interface.name: zwwm_client_connection_manager_v1

description.summary: native client connections and daemon discovery

interface.description: Brokers client launch sockets and named daemon channels through the compositor Wayland connection. Daemon names are scoped to this compositor.

interface.name: zwwm_client_connection_v1

description.summary: one prepared client or daemon connection

interface.description: create_connection supplies a preconnected Wayland socket suitable for WAYLAND_SOCKET. connect_daemon supplies an opaque stream socket paired with the named daemon; the client and daemon define its message format. Exactly one connected or failed event is sent. The receiver owns the fd. Handed-off sockets remain valid independently of this object.

interface.name: zwwm_client_daemon_v1

description.summary: a named client daemon registered with zwwm

interface.description: ready confirms registration. connection delivers one endpoint of a newly connected client's stream. The daemon owns the received fd. Names contain 1..128 ASCII letters, digits, dots, underscores or hyphens. Destroying the object or disconnecting unregisters the name; existing handed-off channels remain valid. Failed registrations reserve no name.
